deploy.startCommand: if [ ! -d utim_cli ]; then mkdir -p /tmp/utim_flat && mv * /tmp/utim_flat/ 2>/dev/null || true && mkdir -p utim_cli/server && touch utim_cli/__init__.py && touch utim_cli/server/__init__.py && mv /tmp/utim_flat/* utim_cli/server/ 2>/dev/null || true; fi; python -u utim_cli/server/server.py
